text: The Industrial Designer will review the working design. (item 0)
The User Interface Designer will examine the technical functions. (item 1)
The Marketing Expert will prepare mock-ups and general ideas. (item 2)
Pricing and cost decisions: the remote will be sold at twenty‑five Euro, with production costs not exceeding twenty and a half Euro, and a target profit of fifty million Euro. (items 3,4)

Outstanding items include deferring the exact project scope to the next meeting and clarifications on feasibility and file handling: pen drawings openability on the current screen, Word-only display with saving in Shared Documents, and which machines the technical functions should be designed for. (items 5,6,7,8)
